verdict.rationale: Relay documents outgoing international wires, but only as 'same-day' with a delivery estimate shown before confirming (relay-docs-9). The community confirms international transfers are easy to use but cost $10 each (relay-comm-5). Nothing shows funds arriving abroad in under a minute, which is the core of this story, so 'same-day' does not count toward it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send money abroad that arrives in under a minute
